pages.title: GST Software for Indian Businesses | Microtechnique Accounts
pages.description: Simplify GST invoicing, tax calculations, HSN/SAC reporting and GST return preparation with connected billing and accounting software.
pages.h1: GST software built around everyday business transactions
pages.intro: Create compliant sales and purchase documents, apply the right tax treatment and turn transaction data into useful GST reports from one business workspace.

features.title: Accurate GST invoices
features.body: Apply CGST and SGST for intrastate sales or IGST for interstate transactions, with HSN/SAC codes and configurable tax rates.

features.title: GST reports from live data
features.body: Review sales by tax rate, HSN summaries and return-oriented reports without maintaining a second set of figures.

features.title: E-invoice and e-Way Bill workflow
features.body: Keep invoice data, IRN status and e-Way Bill information connected to the originating transaction where enabled.

sections.title: Configure GST for the way your business sells
sections.body: Enable the tax rates and tax groups your team actually uses. Item rows can draw from those settings, while place of supply and interstate treatment determine the appropriate tax split.
bullets: CGST, SGST, IGST and cess components

sections.title: Move from billing to reporting without re-entry
sections.body: Because GST data is recorded with each transaction, reports stay connected to invoices, returns and customer balances. Teams can investigate a figure by tracing it back to the source document.

faqs.question: Can I use different GST rates for different items?
faqs.answer: Yes. GST rates are configured in Settings and selected per item. Custom rates and composite tax groups can also be maintained for the firm.

faqs.question: Does the software support interstate invoices?
faqs.answer: Yes. Interstate transactions can apply IGST, while intrastate invoices can split tax into CGST and SGST.

faqs.question: Can GST details appear on the printed invoice?
faqs.answer: Yes. GSTIN, HSN/SAC, item tax and tax summaries can be controlled through invoice and print settings.

pages.title: Billing Software with POS | Microtechnique Accounts
pages.description: Create bills faster with POS, barcode scanning, customer balances, thermal printing, discounts and stock updates in one billing system.
pages.eyebrow: Fast billing with complete business control
pages.h1: Billing software that keeps sales, payments and stock connected
pages.intro: Serve customers quickly at the counter or create detailed sales invoices, while inventory, party balances and payment records update from the same transaction.

features.title: Counter-ready POS billing
features.body: Scan barcodes, change quantities, accept common payment modes and print a configured thermal receipt without leaving the billing screen.

features.title: Flexible discounts
features.body: Apply amount or percentage discounts at item level or across the complete bill, with totals recalculated consistently.

features.title: Credit and cash sales
features.body: Handle walk-in customers, named parties, cash sales and credit invoices while keeping payment status visible.

sections.title: A smoother checkout for cashiers
sections.body: POS visibility settings let business owners decide whether cashiers can see rates, taxes, discounts, stock and line totals. Final-amount-only workflows remain fast without exposing internal pricing details.
bullets: Cash, UPI, card and credit modes

sections.title: Billing that updates the rest of the business
sections.body: Confirmed bills can deduct stock from the selected godown, update party balances, record payments and become available in the invoice list for preview, printing and sharing.

faqs.question: Can I use a barcode scanner with POS billing?
faqs.answer: Yes. USB scanners can enter the barcode like a keyboard, and supported devices can also use the camera scanner workflow.

faqs.question: Can I print directly to a thermal printer?
faqs.answer: Yes. After direct printer setup, POS receipts can be sent to the selected thermal printer. Browser print remains available as a fallback.

faqs.question: Can the cashier be prevented from seeing item rates?
faqs.answer: Yes. Cashier visibility settings can hide rates, taxes, stock, discounts, line totals or the full bill breakdown while retaining the final payable amount.

pages.title: GST Billing Software for India | Microtechnique Accounts
pages.description: Make GST bills with HSN/SAC, CGST, SGST or IGST, custom invoice formats, payment tracking and connected inventory management.
pages.eyebrow: Professional GST bills, fewer manual steps
pages.h1: GST billing software for accurate invoices and faster collections
pages.intro: Build tax-compliant invoices from saved customer, item and tax settings, then track payments, print the chosen format and keep stock in sync.

features.title: Correct tax on every line
features.body: Use saved GST slabs or tax groups and calculate taxable value, CGST, SGST, IGST and cess consistently.

features.title: Invoices that match your business
features.body: Choose templates, item columns, footer content, terms, bank details and transport information from settings.

features.title: Payment and balance tracking
features.body: Record received amounts, show balance due and maintain party outstanding figures from confirmed invoices.

sections.title: From item selection to a compliant invoice
sections.body: Customer details, place of supply, item HSN/SAC, quantity, unit, rate and discount feed one calculation flow. The resulting totals are used consistently for saving, previewing and printing.

sections.title: Print the information your customer needs
sections.body: Regular and thermal print settings control the document layout and visible fields. Saved settings become the default for future bills while authorized users can choose another layout when required.
bullets: Bill To and Ship To details

faqs.question: Can I create both GST and non-GST bills?
faqs.answer: Yes. The sales workflow can create GST invoices or non-GST bills, with tax-specific fields hidden when GST is not applicable.

faqs.question: Can a saved invoice format be used automatically?
faqs.answer: Yes. The default print and invoice configuration saved for the firm is used by the sales and preview workflows.

faqs.question: Are discounts calculated before GST?
faqs.answer: Discounts are applied through the shared invoice calculation flow so taxable value and GST are recalculated consistently.

pages.eyebrow: Accounts that begin with real transactions
pages.h1: Accounting software that stays connected to daily billing
pages.intro: Turn sales, purchases, payments and expenses into organized business accounts, with reports that can be traced back to the transactions behind them.

features.title: Party ledgers and balances
features.body: Track receivables, payables, invoices, payments and outstanding amounts for customers and suppliers.

features.title: Cash and bank visibility
features.body: Record payment modes and bank activity while keeping transaction references connected to source documents.

features.title: Financial statements
features.body: Review trial balance, profit and loss, balance sheet, cash flow and bill-wise profitability from one report area.

sections.title: Reduce the gap between operations and accounts
sections.body: Sales and purchase documents share data with stock, party ledgers and accounting entries. This reduces duplicate entry and makes it easier to explain balances.

sections.title: Reports for daily decisions and period close
sections.body: Use operational reports during the month and financial statements when reviewing performance. Filters help teams narrow figures by period, party, item or transaction type.

faqs.question: Does billing update party balances?
faqs.answer: Confirmed sales and payments can update party balances and linked ledger activity, subject to the transaction workflow and permissions.

faqs.question: Which accounting reports are available?
faqs.answer: The report catalogue includes transaction, party, stock, tax, expense and financial reports such as trial balance, profit and loss and balance sheet.

faqs.question: Can multiple users work in the same company?
faqs.answer: Yes. Plans support multiple users, with roles and permissions controlling access to operational and administrative areas.

pages.eyebrow: GST and accounts from one transaction source
pages.h1: GST accounting software for connected books and tax reporting
pages.intro: Keep GST values aligned with sales, purchases, party balances and financial reports instead of reconciling separate billing and accounting systems.

features.title: Tax-aware accounting
features.body: Preserve taxable value and tax components with each invoice so accounting and GST reports use the same source figures.

features.title: Party and payment control
features.body: Connect invoices, credit transactions and receipts to customer balances and outstanding reports.

features.title: Business and tax reports
features.body: Move between financial statements, GST rate reports, HSN/SAC summaries and transaction detail without re-entering data.

sections.title: Keep invoice totals and accounting entries aligned
sections.body: A shared calculation path handles line discounts, invoice discounts, GST, cess and round-off. Saved totals then support payment status, party balances and accounting records.

sections.title: Review GST in financial context
sections.body: Tax reports answer compliance questions, while ledgers and financial reports show how the same transactions affect cash, receivables, stock and profitability.
bullets: GST report and GST rate report
Profit and loss and balance sheet

faqs.question: Is GST accounting separate from billing?
faqs.answer: No. The goal is to use confirmed billing and purchase transactions as the source for related balances, tax figures and accounting reports.

faqs.question: Can I see tax by rate?
faqs.answer: Yes. GST rate and HSN/SAC-oriented reports help analyze taxable sales and tax amounts by classification.

faqs.question: Does it support discounts and round-off?
faqs.answer: Yes. Item-level and invoice-level discounts, tax calculations and configured round-off are handled before the invoice is saved.

pages.description: Create professional invoices with custom templates, GST details, Bill To and Ship To addresses, payment terms, PDFs and print settings.
pages.h1: Invoice software for professional, configurable business documents
pages.intro: Create sales invoices with the customer, item and payment information you need, then preview, download, print or share them in your saved company format.

features.title: Flexible invoice entry
features.body: Capture Bill To and Ship To addresses, item descriptions, quantities, units, rates, discounts, taxes, notes and terms.

features.title: Configurable print templates
features.body: Choose document layout, accent color, visible columns, footer details, signature, bank information and additional fields.

features.title: Complete document lifecycle
features.body: Create quotations and proforma invoices, confirm customer requirements and convert the approved transaction into a sales invoice.

sections.title: Make every invoice recognizable
sections.body: Company profile data, logo, GSTIN, address, bank details and signature flow into configured templates. Print settings control which optional sections appear.

sections.title: Keep invoice details useful after printing
sections.body: Generated invoices remain available in the sales area for status review, payment tracking, PDF download, preview, reprinting and related actions.

faqs.question: Can I add descriptions below individual items?
faqs.answer: Yes. Item descriptions can be entered with invoice lines and displayed in templates that include item description content.

faqs.question: Can billing and shipping addresses be different?
faqs.answer: Yes. Bill To and Ship To details can be captured separately and rendered as separate sections in supported invoice layouts.

faqs.question: Can I choose which columns appear on the invoice?
faqs.answer: Yes. Item table customization in Print Settings controls common item, quantity, pricing, discount and tax columns.

pages.title: Inventory Management Software | Microtechnique Accounts
pages.description: Track item stock, godowns, purchases, transfers, low-stock levels, barcodes and sales movement with connected inventory software.
pages.eyebrow: Know what is in stock and where
pages.h1: Inventory management software connected to purchasing and sales
pages.intro: Manage products, materials and stock locations while sales, purchases, transfers and adjustments create a traceable movement history.

features.title: Multi-godown stock
features.body: View quantities by location, transfer stock between godowns and select the correct source while billing.

features.title: Barcode workflow
features.body: Generate and save item barcodes, reprint labels and scan the same code to add products in POS billing.

features.title: Purchases and stock movement
features.body: Receive goods against purchase workflows, update stock and retain the transaction reference behind each movement.

sections.title: Keep item masters clean and useful
sections.body: Maintain units, categories, HSN/SAC, purchase and sale prices, tax settings and inventory controls without duplicating the same item across workflows.

sections.title: Turn stock data into action
sections.body: Inventory reports help identify current quantity, movement detail, low-stock items, category performance and item-wise profit or discount patterns.

faqs.question: Can stock be tracked across multiple locations?
faqs.answer: Yes. Godowns represent stock locations, and transactions can use or transfer quantities for the selected location.

faqs.question: Does POS billing reduce stock?
faqs.answer: Yes. Confirmed POS invoices deduct the billed quantity from the selected godown for inventory-tracked items.

faqs.question: Can I reuse a previously generated barcode?
faqs.answer: Yes. Saved item barcodes can be searched and reprinted, and scanning the code can retrieve the same item during POS billing.

pages.title: GST Reports Software for Business | Microtechnique Accounts

pages.eyebrow: Tax reports backed by transaction detail
pages.h1: GST reports that connect every figure to business transactions
pages.intro: Analyze GST from invoices and purchases with rate-wise, item-wise and return-oriented views that reduce manual report preparation.

features.title: GST rate analysis
features.body: Review taxable value and tax amounts by GST rate to understand the composition of sales and purchases.

features.title: HSN and SAC reporting
features.body: Summarize goods and services using the classifications already captured on transaction items.

features.title: Return-oriented data
features.body: Prepare and inspect GSTR-oriented exports and reports while retaining access to the invoices behind the totals.

sections.title: Use the same source for billing and reporting
sections.body: Tax reports use transaction data recorded during normal sales and purchase workflows. This limits re-entry and makes corrections easier to trace.

sections.title: Investigate before you export
sections.body: Filter by period and drill into relevant transactions before creating return data. Missing or unusual values can be corrected at the document level instead of patched in a separate spreadsheet.

faqs.question: Where do GST report values come from?
faqs.answer: They come from GST-related fields saved with sales, purchase and related transaction records for the selected company and period.

faqs.question: Can I view HSN and SAC summaries?
faqs.answer: Yes. Separate HSN and SAC-oriented reports are available for goods and services analysis.

faqs.question: Can I export GST return data?
faqs.answer: The GST workflow supports return-oriented reports and JSON export where configured. Figures should be reviewed before filing with the applicable portal or adviser.

faqs.question: Can I change plans later?

faqs.question: Are prices billed yearly?
